sentences.en: I can't rely on my brother to help me move this weekend.
sentences.zh: 我不能指望这个周末我哥哥来帮我搬家。

sentences.en: She relies on her friends for emotional support during tough times.
sentences.zh: 她依靠朋友在困难时期提供情感支持。

sentences.en: We rely on public transport to get around the city.
sentences.zh: 我们依赖公共交通在城市里出行。
